title: Bannerlord 1.4.8 is live
highlights: The server and all ten Friend Edition mods now run on Bannerlord 1.4.8; War Sails remains disabled and out of scope.
The existing friendallmods1 campaign loaded and autosaved successfully, so no new save was required.
All active mod functions are wired: the 13,729-route authority audit, all 47 Fourberie consequence methods, and the complete 1,865-record Fourberie closure have zero open entries.
A hash-pinned server fix restores Sandbox gameplay initialization while keeping its UI modules headless; BirthAndDeath remains base-campaign behavior without loading the optional UI module.

title: The join freeze is dead
highlights: Joining the server no longer freezes on the "Applying patches..." screen.
If patch-up ever fails again, you get a real error message and a clean return to the menu instead of a frozen loading screen.
Under the hood: two mod-compatibility patches couldn't apply on the game's runtime; they now apply only where they work, with the same protections kept.

title: Army battles and runtime wiring
highlights: Large allied-army battles now field the full army reserve instead of only your entry-time troops.
Retreating from an unresolved battle cleans up properly - no more stale attack loops.
All six gameplay mods verified wired on the dedicated server with exact per-file checks.

title: Raid softlock and kingdom-screen fixes
highlights: Raiding a village no longer soft-locks the raider and flood the server.
Loot totals add up again after raids.
Stuck lords trapped in abandoned map events are freed automatically.
